author: Julie Gale
text:
Thank you Gene. We’ve done the training with a credentialed diabetes educator. Installed the app. Have an iPhone. The sensor stays attached. But Doesn’t work!
Drops out. Loses contact with phone-in the pocket. Goes in and out of updating. And then just dies -usually at 6-7 days. Ask your boss at Abbotts to invest a bit more into R and D and quality control.

author: Gene Holcombe
text: Julie Gale You're not smarty enough to use a basic CGM.  Your best bet is to go back to finger sticks.  Enjoy that!
